findings.issue: observedBySeat destructures each entry without checking it is an object, so a null/undefined entry throws a TypeError ('Cannot destructure ...') instead of the documented RangeError('Invalid observed stats for seat N'). The seat itself is not type-checked either (a non-SeatNumber seat is silently ignored because Map lookup misses).
findings.evidence: No reachable path today: the only caller is recommendPostflop's typed PostflopOptions.observedOpponents; no production code supplies a snapshot yet, the worker AdviceRequest carries no snapshot, and adviceOptions whitelists equity/chart/opponentRanges. It still fails closed (throws; handleAdviceRequest would turn it into ok:false).
findings.fix: Optional: when the session code that builds the snapshot lands (or if it ever crosses the worker boundary), add `if (typeof entry !== 'object' || entry === null)` to the RangeError branch and check `seat` is an integer 1..6. If the snapshot is later carried in AdviceRequest, validate it there like the request id/seed.

summary: No BLOCKER or MAJOR findings. Snapshot validation (ranges.ts observedBySeat): hands must be a non-negative integer, vpip/pfr finite and within 0..100 (rejects NaN, Infinity, strings, out-of-range), duplicate seats throw RangeError; entries are keyed in a Map so prototype keys (__proto__ etc.) cannot pollute anything; a non-array snapshot is ignored (default ranges). n>100 is capped, width<=0 floors at AA, width>=100 takes all classes, so no NaN/unbounded widths reach strongestClasses or equity. Hidden info: estimateOpponentRanges reads only the PlayerView and the snapshot, and ObservedOpponent carries only counts/percentages of public actions (hands, VPIP, PFR) - no hole cards; correctness of how future session code computes them from public actions is out of scope for this change. Bot boundary (REQ-035.3): adviceOptions is a whitelist (equity, chart, opponentRanges) so observedOpponents is dropped for all four bots; no bot calls estimateOpponentRanges/recommendPostflop directly; the worker AdviceRequest has no snapshot field and 'recommend'/'grade' pass only ACTION_RANGE_ADVICE. hand-order.json is a committed, bundled file validated at import by parseHandOrder (format/version, justification length, entry shape with finite numbers, known class via array includes, duplicates, completeness of 169, sorted with grid tie-break, AA first), failing closed with RangeValidationError; error messages truncate untrusted text via echo(). Explanation strings are plain text (no HTML sink); the only interpolated value is an integer hand count. No new dependencies, secrets, network, logging, file I/O or randomness.
